# Frozen companyfacts for the IFRS fiscal-year pins

`tests/test_ifrs_fiscal_year.py` reads these. They track NO page and are never regenerated by
`scripts/build_companyfacts_fixture.py`: each one freezes a real filer whose statements are, or
were, tagged in `ifrs-full` (STATE.md §5.0 row 11 (a),
`docs/records/2026-11-17-an-ifrs-filers-fiscal-year-is-read-from-its-ifrs-statements.md`).

Cut 2026-11-17 from the primary checkout's SEC cache (the cached response's `text`, decoded as
`EdgarClient.companyfacts` decodes it), unmodified apart from the tag subset. Each keeps, in the
exact companyfacts shape, `sort_keys` and `indent=1` like the other frozen fixtures:
- every alias (`vinci.edgar.concepts.CONCEPT_ALIASES`) of the eight flow concepts, and every
  `SUBSTITUTES` tag;
- `vinci.edgar.net_debt.READ_TAGS`, so the snapshot reads a real net debt;
- the four balance-sheet totals `reporting_currency` reads (`Assets`, `Liabilities`,
  `LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity`, `StockholdersEquity`);
- in `ifrs-full`, only the `IFRS_FLOW_TAGS`.

Other namespaces (`srt`, `invest`) are dropped.

**Checked at cut time, against the full blob, at main 6110795d and at this branch:**
`filer_fiscal_year`, `current_annual` for each of the eight flow concepts and
`compute_fundamental_snapshot` read the same on the subset as on the full blob, both on the whole
blob and cut at 2026-10-16 (screen run 2026-10-16-01's price date).
